howto.when: 当你配置服务间路由、实施金丝雀或蓝绿发布,或设置熔断、重试等弹性模式时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude produces ready-to-apply Istio YAML templates: VirtualService routing, canary releases, circuit breakers, retries/timeouts, traffic mirroring, fault injection and ingress Gateways, plus istioctl analyze and debug commands.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up service-to-service routing, canary or blue-green deployments, or resilience patterns like circuit breakers and retries in Istio.
